title: Love Love
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Matthew 19:13-15: people bring children for Jesus to bless, the disciples rebuke them, Jesus says "Let the little children come to me", places his hands on them; God loves children.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Jesus showed kindness to people in need.
floor.question: What did Jesus do for the hungry crowd?

representations: a picture of Jesus with children
a speech bubble for the disciples and one for Jesus
steps: What did Jesus do for them?
contexts: an older pupil helping a younger one

board.do: Draw two speech bubbles: the disciples and Jesus.

board.say: What did Jesus say about the children?

board.do: Wait for the child to say "Let the little children come to me".

misconceptions.ask: What did the disciples do when people brought children to Jesus?

listen_for: Send them away, I am busy
misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus say about the children?

listen_for: Nothing, he only spoke to the adults
misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus do for the children?

listen_for: Only to grown-ups who have done a lot
misconceptions.ask: To whom does the kingdom of heaven belong, according to Matthew 19:14?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 19:14 and ask: who does Jesus point to? Children are welcomed now.

checks.question: What did the disciples do when children were brought?
What did Jesus do for the children?
checks.answer: Placed his hands on them and blessed them
